description: MedLLaMA is a community-developed medical domain fine-tune of LLaMA, NOT an official Meta release. Various versions exist from different researchers, fine-tuned on medical literature and datasets for healthcare-related tasks.

outOfScope: Any real medical advice - FOR RESEARCH ONLY

trainingData.description: Fine-tuned on medical corpora including PubMed Central articles and medical instruction datasets. Base model is LLaMA.

trainingProcedure: Continued pretraining and/or instruction tuning on medical datasets from base LLaMA model.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Improved performance on medical benchmarks compared to base LLaMA. However, not validated for clinical use.

knownLimitations: Should NOT be used for medical diagnosis or treatment

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: May reflect biases in medical literature training data.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: FOR RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY. Not validated for clinical applications.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Should not be used with real patient data without proper safeguards.

access.note: License terms vary by specific variant

disclaimer: This is NOT an official Meta product. It is a community fine-tune for research purposes only. Do not use for medical diagnosis or treatment.
